title: Fatboy Slim ft. Bootsy Collins - Weapon Of Choice [Official 4k Video]
summary: The restored 4k official music video for Fatboy Slim's Weapon of Choice featuring Bootsy Collins, directed by Spike Jonze, with Christopher Walken dancing around a hotel lobby. It won multiple MTV awards and a Grammy.
why: HN mentions it mostly in passing as a joke or trivia, such as noting that Spike Jonze appears as a dancer.
